name: dsh-multi-panel
author: Marc Uy Dagatan
description: Independent split chat workspaces and vertically or horizontally docked side-panel tabs for DSH

scripts.test:portable: node --test test/split-model.test.mjs test/workspace-state.test.mjs test/preferences.test.mjs test/settings.test.mjs test/workspace.test.mjs test/shortcuts.test.mjs test/workspace-tabs.test.mjs test/workspace-tabs-view.test.mjs
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run format:check
scripts.format: prettier --write client/*.mjs client/*.css client/*.md scripts/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md RELEASING.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs/*.md docs/media/*.md docs/media/*.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client/*.mjs client/*.css client/*.md scripts/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md RELEASING.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs/*.md docs/media/*.md docs/media/*.json .github/workflows/*.yml
